#### Bookmarking
----------------

This is a way to take a snapshot of your current work in Carnation so that you
can continue where you left off later or share your work with others.

**Key Points**

- Adjust settings or change multiple plots, then save a bookmark to save your
  progress.
- Bookmarks are saved on a per-project and per-analysis level. The bookmark
  summary table will show the time when a bookmark was saved and details about
  who created it.
- Bookmarks are stored on the server. When you make a bookmark, everyone who
  has access to that analysis will be able to see and load that bookmark.
  Conversely, links to bookmarks will only work for people who already have
  access to that analysis.
- To clear or "unload" a bookmark, reload an analysis by clicking the "Go!"
  button. To be completely sure that everything is fresh, start a new session
  without following a bookmark link.


**To Load**
- Select your project and analysis by clicking on the project/analysis tables
  or dropdown menus.
- If there are existing bookmarks for that analysis, a table listing saved
  bookmarks will appear below the analysis description table.
- Click on the table to select one and then click "Load". This will also update
  the URL in the browser address bar.
- After loading a bookmark, refreshing the browser page (without changing the
  address bar) will reload your saved bookmark.

**To Save**
- To save your progress or current settings during your work on carnation,
  click the "Bookmark" button at the top right of the screen.
- This will bring up a popup asking you to enter a name/label for your
  bookmark.
- If you had started with a saved bookmark, the label field will be pre-filled with
  that bookmark's label for you to edit.
- You can overwrite an existing bookmark if you had originally created it, by
  setting *Force overwrite* to `TRUE`.
- This popup menu also shows a list of other existing bookmarks for that analysis.
  To do a variation on one of the existing labels, click the table to select
  and populate the name field with that label.
